verified_claims.text: 索引程序為 Podcast 資料集建立了 8,564 個 nodes、20,691 個 edges，為 News 資料集建立了 15,754 個 nodes、19,520 個 edges。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
The indexing process resulted in a graph consisting of 8,564 nodes and 20,691 edges for the Podcast
dataset, and a larger graph of 15,754 nodes and 19,520 edges for the News dataset.

verified_claims.text: 全域方法相對向量 RAG，在 Podcast 與 News 的 comprehensiveness 與 diversity 上皆顯著較佳。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
As shown in Figure 2 and Table 6, global approaches signifi-
cantly outperformed conventional vector RAG (SS) in both comprehensiveness and diversity criteria
across datasets.

verified_claims.text: 相對 SS，全域方法的 comprehensiveness win rates 在 Podcast 為 72–83%（p<.001）、News 為 72–80%（p<.001）；diversity win rates 分別為 75–82%（p<.001）與 62–71%（p<.01）。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
Specifically, global approaches achieved comprehensiveness win rates between 72-
83% (p<.001) for Podcast transcripts and 72-80% (p<.001) for News articles, while diversity win
rates ranged from 75-82% (p<.001) and 62-71% (p<.01) respectively.

verified_claims.text: Directness 的 validity test 顯示，向量 RAG 在所有比較中產生最直接的回答。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
Our use of directness as a
validity test confirmed that vector RAG produces the most direct responses across all comparisons.

verified_claims.text: GraphRAG 的 community summaries 相較 source texts，通常對回答的 comprehensiveness 與 diversity 帶來小幅但一致的改善，root-level summaries 是例外。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
When comparing community summaries to source texts
using GraphRAG, community summaries generally provided a small but consistent improvement
in answer comprehensiveness and diversity, except for root-level summaries.

verified_claims.text: 相較 source text summarization，C3 的 GraphRAG 少用 26–33% context tokens，C0 則少用超過 97%。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
Table 2 also illustrates the scalability advantages of GraphRAG compared
to source text summarization: for low-level community summaries (C3), GraphRAG required 26-
33% fewer context tokens, while for root-level community summaries (C0), it required over 97%
fewer tokens.

verified_claims.text: 以平均 extracted claims 衡量時，News 與 Podcast 的所有 global search 條件 C0–C3 及 TS 都比 SS 更具 comprehensiveness，且所有差異皆達 p<.05。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
For both the News and Podcast datasets, all global search
conditions (C0-C3) and source text summarization (TS) had greater comprehensiveness than vector
RAG (SS). The differences were statistically significant (p<.05) in all cases.

verified_claims.text: Claim-based diversity 結果中，Podcast 的所有 global search 條件在所有距離閾值皆顯著優於 SS；News 則只有 C0 在所有距離閾值皆顯著優於 SS（p<.05）。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
For the Podcast dataset, all global search conditions had significantly greater diversity than SS
across all distance thresholds (p<.05), consistent with the win rates observed in Experiment 1. For
the News dataset, however, only C0 significantly outperformed SS across all distance thresholds
(p<.05).

verified_claims.text: 兩個資料集在 comprehensiveness 與 diversity 上，global search 各條件彼此之間以及 global search 與 TS 之間都沒有統計顯著差異。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
For both comprehensiveness and diversity, across both datasets, there were no statistically significant
differences observed among the global search conditions or between global search and TS.

verified_claims.text: 在彙整後 LLM 標籤不是 tie 的案例中，這些案例占 comprehensiveness 配對比較的 33%、diversity 的 39%；LLM 標籤與 claim-based 標籤的一致率分別為 78% 與 69–70%。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
As a result, we focused on cases where the aggregated LLM
label was not a tie, representing 33% and 39% of pairwise comparisons for comprehensiveness and
diversity, respectively. In these cases, the aggregated LLM label matched the claim-based label in
78% of pairwise comparisons for comprehensiveness and 69-70% for diversity (across all distance
thresholds), indicating moderately strong alignment.
